question_bank.stem: For a mobile photo-search feature that would otherwise upload photos to a backend service, what benefit does the on-device small-AI approach provide?

options.label: A
options.text: It increases cloud dependence while reducing the need for local chips.

options.label: B
options.text: It removes user-interface work while increasing server-side complexity.

options.label: C
options.text: It lowers privacy exposure, latency, and backend service cost.

options.label: D
options.text: It replaces application design with a larger hosted frontier model.

question_bank.correct_answer: It lowers privacy exposure, latency, and backend service cost.
question_bank.explanation: The Alipay example motivates on-device AI by citing privacy, latency, and the cost of standing up a backend service.
